scene.label: City & Urban
scene.description: Dense or clearly urban built environment.

scene.label: Residential
scene.description: Homes, apartments, or residential neighborhoods are visually central.

scene.label: Industrial
scene.description: Warehouses, ports, factories, or industrial infrastructure are central.

scene.label: Coastal
scene.description: Open ocean, beach, sea cliffs, or exposed ocean coastline is visually central. Do not use for bay, marina, harbor, river, lake, or urban waterfront alone.

subject.label: Roads
subject.description: A road, highway, intersection, or moving road network is a meaningful subject, not a tiny incidental detail.

subject.label: Waterfront
subject.description: Bay, marina, harbor, river edge, lake edge, or urban water edge is a meaningful subject. Prefer waterfront over coastal unless ocean/beach/cliff coastline is clearly central.

subject.label: Architecture
subject.description: Buildings or designed structures are a meaningful subject.

subject.label: Skyline
subject.description: A recognizable city skyline or broad building silhouette is central.

subject.label: Bridge
subject.description: A bridge is visibly meaningful in the composition.

subject.label: Mountain
subject.description: A mountain or mountain range is visibly meaningful.

subject.label: Campus
subject.description: A university, school, or institutional campus is visually central.

style.label: Golden Hour
style.description: Warm low-angle sunlight or visibly golden illumination.

style.label: Blue Hour
style.description: Twilight blue ambience before sunrise or after sunset.

style.label: Clear Skies
style.description: Mostly clear visible sky with limited cloud obstruction.

style.label: Night
style.description: The scene is clearly nighttime or dominated by artificial light.

use.label: Establishing
use.description: Footage suitable to introduce a place or setting before a tighter scene. Common for aerial place-establishing shots; expected often. Always pair with subject/scene tags that describe what is being established.

use.label: Background
use.description: Visually steady footage suitable behind text, narration, or graphics.

use.label: Transition
use.description: A dynamic movement or reveal suitable between scenes.

use.label: Detail
use.description: A tighter view focused on a specific visual detail rather than a broad setting.
